fields.title: 5. Corrections and Resolutions from the Previous Issue
fields.md:
- **1 source restored**: The October issue's split of "bank loans of about $10 billion + IG bonds of about $30 billion" was not in Semafor 10/07, but the **FT report of 2026-10-06** (republished by Reuters 10/07) is the original source — arranged by Apollo, negotiated with a small number of lenders including PIMCO, closing expected in 2027 ([Manila Times/Reuters 10/08](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/business/foreign-business/spacex-seeks-40-billion-financing-led-by-apollo-to-buy-nvidia-chips/2441146) · [investinglive 10/07](https://investinglive.com/stocks/spacex-seeks-40-billion-in-debt-led-by-apollo-to-fund-nvidia-chip-order-ft-says/)). The previous issue's downgrade to 'source unconfirmed' is lifted. However, it differs from the 3-tranche private bond structure in Bloomberg 10/23 — we read this as the structure having changed within two weeks (estimate).
- **1 still unresolved**: The original source of "5-year CDS 197.6bp" has still not been found. Semafor 10/22 only says "CDS widened" (source: Section 1, rates row).
- **Still not adopted**: Gokhshtein "$8.3 billion price finalized" (10/22) (source: previous issue, Section 1).
